description: Evidence repeats History's commit rows with less context: a 40-character hash in small monospace and the message, with no author, time or link. History already shows the short hash, author, message and time.
expected: Evidence adds value (author, time, short hash with copy, files changed or diffstat) or merges into History.
suggested_fix: Show the short hash with copy-full, author, time and diffstat; or drop Evidence in favour of a commit filter on History.

description: `pardner commit` writes `.agent-trace/` and creates an untracked `.gitignore` in the repository root, so the tree is dirty right after a successful commit. The trace JSON also reports `diff.stat: ""` for a commit that changed a file, and `agent.name` is the raw Actor ID.
expected: The trace directory is ignored without dirtying the tree (e.g. via .git/info/exclude), and the diffstat is filled.
suggested_fix: Write the ignore rule to .git/info/exclude; compute the diffstat from the new commit (HEAD^..HEAD).
